reason: The prospectively frozen two-chunk rerun used 3032-row condition batches. It occupied the serial GPU lane for 99 minutes and terminated with exit 137 without a result artifact. The earlier diagnostic already showed that one 3032-row native full-logit forward requires a 10.23 GiB allocation while the process holds 25.34 GiB, so the two-chunk sizing was unsafe rather than scientifically informative.

observability_statement.only_new_observation: The 3032-row physical batch plan can stall and be killed even after passing focused CPU tests.

authorized_change.condition_chunks: Deterministic contiguous half-open slices [0,256), [256,512), ... with final slice [5888,6064), preserving original order on every batch axis.
authorized_change.storage: For each slice, offload logits to CPU, retain only the registered subject-position vocabulary vector for scientific scoring, and compute the unchanged same-batch native-noop full-logit maximum before discarding the transient full tensors.
authorized_change.role_forwards: Keep the native and decomposed 48-example role passes unchanged.
